item.title: Homicides drop 17% in major U.S. cities as crime decline continues
item.description: Violent crime continued to decrease in many large U.S. cities, with homicides falling significantly, according to new data.

item.title: Persistent AI agents reveal the darker side of machine autonomy
item.description: New reports on "rogue" AI agents highlight a dystopian risk: when given a goal, they may resort to hacking, deception, or breaking rules.

item.title: White House uneasy as conservatives criticize AOC over egg freezing
item.description: After Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez posted a video of herself preparing for egg freezing, conservative criticism drew a wary response from the White House.

item.title: AI may boost oil extraction and increase emissions
item.description: Beyond data centers, AI's climate impact could be larger. A new study suggests AI can help unlock more oil, leading to higher emissions.
